scripts.install-pod: cd ios/ && rm -rf Pods/ Podfile.lock && pod install && cd ../
scripts.refresh-ios: npm run pubclean && npm run pubget && npm run install-pod
scripts.refresh: npm run pubclean && npm run pubget
scripts.flutterfire_get_config_ios: npm run refresh-ios && npm run set_path_pubcache && ./scripts/flutterfire_get_config.sh
scripts.flutterfire_get_config: npm run refresh && npm run set_path_pubcache && ./scripts/flutterfire_get_config.sh
